steps.name: deck lanes and calibration against the release candidate
steps.shell:
set -euo pipefail
output=edenfs-exploratory-release-decks
mkdir -p "$output/replays"
runtime_dir="/run/user/$(id -u)"
test -S "$runtime_dir/bus" || { echo "no user DBus session bus at $runtime_dir/bus"; exit 1; }
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$runtime_dir"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$runtime_dir/bus"
sl help agent > /dev/null
sl help log > /dev/null
EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT=$(sl --reason 'Capture release candidate daemon source - sl help log' log -r . -T '{node}')
EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP=$(sl --reason 'Capture release candidate daemon source time - sl help log' log -r "$EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT" -T '{date|hgdate}' | awk '{print $1}')
export EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP
build_output=$(mktemp)
buck2 build @fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//eden/fs/service:edenfs --show-full-output > "$build_output"
EDENFS_SERVER_PATH=$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $2}' "$build_output")
export EDENFS_SERVER_PATH
export EDENFS_DAEMON_FATAL_EDEN_BUG=false
pinned_sut="$output/pinned-sut/edenfs"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$pinned_sut")"
manifold get "${EDEN_EXPLORATORY_PINNED_SUT_MANIFOLD:?set to the pinned pre-fix edenfs object, e.g. eden_exploratory/pinned-sut/<sha256>/edenfs}" "$pinned_sut"
chmod +x "$pinned_sut"
env_args=(--env "EDENFS_SERVER_PATH=$EDENFS_SERVER_PATH" --env "XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" --env "DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=$DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS" --env "EDENFS_DAEMON_FATAL_EDEN_BUG=false" --env "EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT=$EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_COMMIT" --env "EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP=$EDENFS_DAEMON_SOURCE_TIMESTAMP")
buck2 test @fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//eden/integration/correctness/exploratory:decks_live_test -- "${env_args[@]}" --env EDEN_EXPLORATORY_REPLAYS=1
set +e
buck2 test @fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//eden/integration/correctness/exploratory:decks_test -- "${env_args[@]}" --env EDEN_EXPLORATORY_REPLAYS=1 --env "EDEN_EXPLORATORY_ARTIFACTS=$PWD/$output/replays" --env "EDEN_EXPLORATORY_PINNED_SUT=$PWD/$pinned_sut"
echo "calibration and advisory replays exit: $?"
set -e
buck2 run -c fbcc.rust=False @fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//eden/integration/correctness/exploratory:explore -- release-summary --target edenfs --decks fbcode/eden/integration/correctness/exploratory/decks --artifacts "$output/replays" > "$output/release-summary.json"
cat "$output/release-summary.json"

description: Release-week deck lanes: accept and not-evaluated decks and the calibration pair block; reject decks are advisory (release-summary lists the reproduced ones). Set hash to the release candidate commit and EDEN_EXPLORATORY_PINNED_SUT_MANIFOLD in the job environment.
